documents.notes: Workbook with sheets 'Commitment & Spend' (table 'Allocation, Spend & Commitment, £ Millions', 'Source: RD&S, 30-09-2023'), 'EOIs' (allocation, commitment and spend by scheme) and 'Performance Indicators'. A footnote cites the last approved programme modification dated 26 January 2022. No issuer is named in the cells and no document type is printed beyond the table headings; the publication page calls it 'Rural Development Plan: money allocated, committed and spent'. A careful clerk would have to compose a type: review. Traps: the modification date; scheme names as parties.
